title: Kathmandu ↔ Pokhara Tourist Bus
summary: Daily AC tourist coaches on the Prithvi Highway — scenic Trishuli River and hill country, sofa seats, bottled water, and scheduled stops for breakfast, lunch, and snacks.

heroAlt: World Touch tourist coach for the Kathmandu–Pokhara route
overview: World Touch runs morning tourist buses both ways between Kathmandu and Pokhara on the Prithvi Highway. This is the same road most trekkers and lake visitors use — not a local microbus, but a marked tourist coach with reserved seats and a crew that drives it every day.

The journey is genuinely scenic: the road drops into the Trishuli River gorge, climbs through middle hills and terraced valleys, and — when the sky is clear — opens toward Annapurna and Manaslu foothills before Pokhara. Drivers take the curves carefully; we would rather arrive a little late than rush the gorge.

We operate AC tourist coaches with wide sofa-style seats and a complimentary water bottle when you board. The day includes planned stops so you can stretch, use a clean restroom, and buy breakfast early on, lunch around the highway towns, and tea or snacks later — meals are at your cost, but the timing is built into the trip.

Book through our Thamel desk with the same team that handles treks and tours. If you are linking a bus seat to Annapurna or Pokhara plans, tell us your hotel and dates and we will align pickup and drop.
history: Most of the day you are beside or above the Trishuli, then on open ridge sections with green hills and, in season, snow peaks on the horizon. It is one of the classic overland days in Nepal — best enjoyed with a window seat, an early start, and realistic expectations for mountain traffic.

notes: Scenic stretch along the Trishuli River and through hill country toward Pokhara.
Clear-weather views of Annapurna-range foothills and wider Himalayan skylines.
Morning departures only — we do not run overnight buses on this route.
Scheduled stops for breakfast (early on the road), lunch (Mugling / highway stop), and tea or snacks.
Mountain weather and road works can add time — crews adjust rather than hurry blind corners.
Pokhara drop at the lakeside tourist-bus area; Kathmandu drop at Thamel / Sorhakhutte tourist-bus zone, with hotel pickup on morning departures where noted.

policies.title: Booking
policies.detail: Reserve by WhatsApp, email, or the contact form. Same-day seats are sometimes available before 6:00 if the coach is not full — ask, do not assume.

policies.title: Payment
policies.detail: Pay at our Thamel desk, by bank transfer, or in cash on boarding for confirmed bookings. Card payment can be arranged in the office.

policies.title: Cancellation
policies.detail: Changes are free up to 24 hours before departure. Later cancellations may hold the seat if we cannot resell it.

policies.title: Luggage
policies.detail: One trek duffel and one cabin bag is the usual allowance. Extra cargo needs a check with us first.

policies.title: ID
policies.detail: Carry your passport. Crews may note names against the manifest on tourist coaches.

faqs.question: How long is the Kathmandu to Pokhara bus?
faqs.answer: Plan on 7 to 8 hours, including breakfast and lunch stops. Landslides or traffic near Mugling can make it longer.

faqs.question: Is the route scenic?
faqs.answer: Yes. You follow the Trishuli River through gorges and hills, with middle-country views and, on clear days, Himalayan peaks toward Pokhara. Window seats are worth asking for when you book.

faqs.question: What is included on the bus?
faqs.answer: Reserved seat, AC cabin, sofa-style seating, and a water bottle on boarding. Breakfast, lunch, and snacks are at highway stops — you pay for your own food and drinks there.

faqs.question: Is the tourist bus safe?
faqs.answer: It is the standard way international travelers do this route. We use established highway coaches, morning departures, and crews who drive this road daily. It is still a mountain highway — we do not oversell it as a flight.

faqs.question: Can I book both directions?
faqs.answer: Yes. Most trek guests book Kathmandu to Pokhara before the trek and Pokhara to Kathmandu after.

faqs.question: Do you pick up from my hotel?
faqs.answer: Thamel hotels are covered on morning Kathmandu departures for many coaches. Outside Thamel, ask us — we will say clearly if you need to reach the bus park.

faqs.question: Is there Wi-Fi?
faqs.answer: Do not count on it. Mobile data works on much of the highway and drops in the gorges.
